title: checkout-api: a cache expiry causes a burst of identical database queries
impact: slow page loads on the account dashboard
symptoms: a cache expiry causes a burst of identical database queries
log_excerpt:
INFO   TTL batch expiry: 240000 keys evicted simultaneously
ERROR  redis GET catalog:home returned nil for 94% of requests
ERROR  database connections 18 -> 400, rejecting new queries
resolution: added jittered TTLs and a single-flight lock on cache refill

title: reporting-etl: 5xx responses begin immediately after a rollout completes

INFO   rollout 4f2a1c completed, 100% traffic shifted
